footnotes: From pre-tax loss to net loss to Lucid: includes a $2.3M income tax benefit; after $984M of preferred dividends.

Figures are from the company's Form 10-K for fiscal years ended Dec 31, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue rose 67.6% to $1.4B in 2025. Gross margin was -92.8%, versus -114.3% a year earlier, and the operating loss widened to $3.5B from $3.0B.
The net loss widened to $3.7B, or −$12.09 per share, from $3.1B. Operating cash flow was −$2.9B and free cash flow −$3.8B, versus −$2.9B.
sources: Lucid Group, Inc. Form 10-K for FY2025 (SEC EDGAR)
